resale_co.name: New Tenant/Resale Certificate (Certificate of Continued Occupancy, CCO)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Bergenfield Construction Code Department / Code Enforcement (GovPilot form is headed Code Enforcement)
requirements: Inspection of the home before the sale (exterior and interior checklist: walkways, stairs and handrails, roof, gutters, paint, house number, plumbing, sump pump discharge, heater venting, debris, hedges, unregistered vehicles, broken glass, deadbolt with thumb latch, water heater relief valve extension, removal of basement kitchens built without permits)
Smoke detectors on each level and carbon monoxide detectors within 10 feet of bedrooms (sealed units if not hardwired)
Licensed plumber's Water Service Line check (lead or galvanized) and backflow preventer certification if there is a lawn or fire sprinkler system, before an inspection is scheduled
Sump Pump Certification if the house has a sump pump, before an inspection is scheduled
Notarized application signed by owner and purchaser, attesting to the use (one family / two family) and maximum occupancy
Owner certifies the dwelling meets zoning and that no rubbish, debris or bulk garbage will be left before new occupancy
Agreement of Use Regarding Basement/Attic and Verification of Occupancy (rental registration notice) forms in the application packet

fees.label: Resale/new tenant certificate with smoke/CO inspection, single-family or condo (online fee table; reinspection $25)
fees.quote: Single-family residence / Condominium / Commercial property Reinspection fee: $25 $95.00

fees.label: Resale/new tenant certificate with smoke/CO inspection, two-family (online fee table; reinspection $25)
Paper application, one family: $50.00 certificate fee plus $45.00 fire fee
Paper application, two family: $75.00 certificate fee plus $45.00 fire fee

resale_co.how_to_apply: Apply online with the Borough's GovPilot New Tenant/Resale Certificate form (or the notarized paper application from the Construction Code Department, 198 N. Washington Ave.). Attach the notarized forms, the water service line/backflow confirmation number and, if there is a sump pump, the Sump Pump Certification. The fee covers the certificate and the smoke/CO inspection.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Code Dept. (Code Enforcement Officer: Joe Picheo, JPicheo@bergenfieldnj.gov, (201) 387-4055 ext 4)

evidence.quote: A New Tenant/Resale Certificate is required by the Borough of Bergenfield when a property is being sold or a new tenant is moving in.

Bergenfield requires a licensed plumber to check the Water Service Line for lead or galvanized material and if there is sprinkler system (lawn or fire) for certification of a backflow preventer PRIOR to an inspection being scheduled.
If the property has a Sump Pump you MUST submit a Sump Pump Certification BEFORE an inspection can be scheduled.
Single-family residence / Condominium / Commercial property Reinspection fee: $25 $95.00
APPLICATION FOR RESALE OR RENTAL CERTIFICATE FOR ONE FAMILY, TWO FAMILY AND MULTIPLE DWELLINGS

resale_co.notes: Bergenfield's online GovPilot form says a New Tenant/Resale Certificate is required whenever a property is sold or a new tenant moves in; the form refers to the result as a CCO. The online fee table shows $95.00 (single-family/condo) and $120.00 (two-family) under 'Inspection Certificate - Smoke / Carbon Monoxide Detector', which matches the paper form's $50.00 + $45.00 fire fee and $75.00 + $45.00 fire fee, so these appear to be the same combined charge, not two separate charges. The paper application (bergenfieldnj.gov, uploaded 2025-02) is a scanned image PDF, so its quotes cannot be text-matched. No validity period or lead time is published. Separately, Chapter 239 (Rental Property) requires annual registration and an inspection on every change in occupancy for two-family houses and non-owner-occupied single-family houses (a rental program, waived for an owner-occupied unit); that is not a resale requirement but buyers of two-family homes must register any rental unit ($50 per unit).

requirements: Smoke detectors on each level of the dwelling, including basements (excluding attic or crawl space); 10 year sealed units on the CSDCMAC form
Smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detector outside each separate sleeping area (within 10 feet of bedrooms)
All smoke and carbon monoxide detectors in working order

authorities.name: Borough of Bergenfield (smoke/CO certificate taken with the resale certificate application; Bergenfield Fire Prevention Bureau is the fire code enforcing agency)

fees.label: Smoke/CO fire fee included in the resale application (paper form)

authorities.how_to_apply: The smoke detector and carbon monoxide certificate is applied for together with the New Tenant/Resale Certificate (GovPilot form or paper application with the notarized one and two family CSDCMAC page). Payment must accompany the application (credit card, check or money order payable to Borough of Bergenfield).
authorities.contact_title: Fire Official (Fire Inspector: Lou Turso, ext 4074; Fire Prevention Clerk: Sharon Rugel, ext 4174)

evidence.quote: APPLICATION FOR ONE & TWO FAMILY DWELLING CERTIFICATION OF SMOKE DETECTORS AND CARBON MONOXIDE ALARM COMPLIANCE (CSDCMAC)

fire_cert.notes: The Fire Prevention Bureau page does not describe the resale smoke/CO certificate; it is handled through the Borough's combined resale application (fee table heading: 'Inspection Certificate - Smoke / Carbon Monoxide Detector'). The NJ DCA LEA registry lists Bergenfield as its own fire department LEA and the state directory lists Fire Official Kevin R Cook, (201) 387-4055, fire-prevention@bergenfield.com (the Borough page uses fireprevention@bergenfieldnj.gov). The online form still lists fire extinguishers, which state law (P.L.2025, c.19) removed from the sale certificate in February 2025. No tiered rush fees are published.

other_items.label: Water service line and backflow certification
other_items.detail: A licensed plumber must check the water service line for lead or galvanized material, and certify any backflow preventer if there is a lawn or fire sprinkler system, before the resale inspection is scheduled.

other_items.label: Sump pump certification
other_items.detail: If the house has a sump pump, a Sump Pump Certification must be submitted before the inspection can be scheduled; the pump must drain outside and cannot be connected to the sewer.

other_items.label: Rental registration for two-family homes
other_items.detail: Buyers who will rent a unit must register with Code Enforcement (annual registration by February 15, $50 per rental unit); two-family and non-owner-occupied homes are inspected on every change in occupancy.

open_questions: How long is the Bergenfield resale certificate valid, and how many days ahead should sellers apply?
Is the online $95.00 / $120.00 the full combined charge (certificate plus $45.00 fire fee), as it appears?
Is a separate Zoning Certificate ($50.00 single-family / $60.00 two-family on the online fee table) required on a sale?
Does the Borough still require a fire extinguisher for resale after P.L.2025, c.19?
